title: Precision Selection, Transform, Snapping, Vector Geometry, Paths & Edit History
objective: Implement the map-bounded object/vector editing kernel over the MCS-01 cartography document foundation: precision selection and grouping, transforms and alignment, snapping/guides, vector/path editing and reversible creator history while keeping canonical owner history and live Scene/runtime state outside MCS authority.

scope.purpose: Provide the bounded MCS object/vector editing kernel over MCS-01 authoring identities without becoming canonical World, Scene, spatial or owner-history authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative MCS document objects can be selected, transformed, snapped and vector/path-edited deterministically with reversible creator history while canonical owner history, live Scene placement and owner-domain truth remain unchanged.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json were reconsulted after MCS-01 exact-tree publication. MCS-01 creates no rotation detour; MCS-03 is the next surviving MCS tranche in strict order.

MCS-03 consumes the MCS-01 workspace/document/layer/object identity foundation. It may edit MCS authoring projections but cannot silently promote those edits into canonical World, Scene, Combat, Exploration, Visibility, Settlement, Economy or semantic-spatial truth.
MAI remains map asset/package/projection authority; ISE/Scene/Tabletop remain live canvas/camera/placement authority; SSA/World remain semantic spatial truth authority.
The MCS program definition requires reversible creator history while canonical owner history remains separate. MCS-03 may not create or rewrite owner-domain event/history ledgers.
MCS-05, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work are not authorized by this tranche.
next_action: Establish the smallest causal RED for MCS-03 through the public object/vector editing seam before writing production implementation.
